sections.title: Before booking in Fort Collins
sections.html:
If your main problem is lipstick selection, bring the products you actually reach for and ask whether their review is included. If you want a lesson, check whether you will practise the techniques yourself and leave with the steps. If makeup is not your priority, focus the session on clothing neutrals, metals and a few wearable combinations instead of paying for an application you will not use.

  • Is the makeup component an application, a hands-on lesson or product advice?
  • Which add-ons are outside my quoted total?

sections.title: Make the result useful in your everyday wardrobe
sections.html: Use photo previews to narrow a group of colors you want to discuss, then compare real products when texture and finish matter. A matte berry lipstick and a sheer berry balm can behave differently even when their color family is similar. For clothes, test the suggested palette against one existing outfit before buying several new pieces. The most useful result is a repeatable choice, not a larger shopping list.
